svg.text: 2 · an Environment on Launch and Run
Launch offers the usable ones; the rest: Not offered
the default is chosen until you pick another
New environment saves, lists it again and chooses it
Run detail names the run's own environment
unreadable: Resume waits, the reason said
fixed in 0f6b9c7e: the stub routes by URL
the board's aside summary and Before
split out: built in step 3, FU-P3-86h
open, minor: CR-P3FU86G-05, -06 a test title,
a warning that does not block
Summary: pipeline, engine, environment, head, tasks
Before Launch lists every reason Launch waits
a reason is a link: its section opens, focus moves
the preview in the aside is folded at first
no blocker, no major: round 1 approve, 6 minors
CR-P3FU86H-01, a link into a folded group with
a server error; -02, the Environment row; -04:
open, minor: CR-P3FU86H-03 engine text written
twice; -05 no test of Choose where it runs and
no browser run; -06 inbox 146 item 2, later
each view is a history entry
Back steps through them, Forward again
the engines' versions, off the first click
kept, to scale, 1.3 px a second
after that: the stale answer at once, and one
refresh behind it; only the very first call waits
